description_en: Retrieves a single start or stop operation record and the log content. Available since version 6.4.0
description_zh: 获取单条启停操作记录及日志正文，上线版本：v6.4.0
name: GetStreamOpsRecord

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Dataphin project to which the task belongs. This parameter is used for permission verification in the production environment
parameters.help_zh: 任务所属的Dataphin项目ID，用于生产环境权限校验
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the operation record. Set this parameter to the opsRecordId value returned by the ListStreamOpsRecords operation
parameters.name: ops_record_id

Data.description_en: The start or stop operation record of the real-time task. You can call the GetStreamOpsRecord operation to query the log content by using the log storage identifier in the list
Data.description_zh: 实时任务的启停操作记录；列表中的日志存储标识可通过 GetStreamOpsRecord 查询为日志正文

DeploymentId.description_en: The deployment ID of the task. This ID is used to identify the deployment and is different from the specific running instance ID deploymentInstanceId
DeploymentId.description_zh: 任务的部署ID，用于标识部署，与具体运行实例ID deploymentInstanceId 不同

DeploymentInstanceId.description_en: The deployment instance ID associated with this operation. This ID corresponds to the DeploymentInstanceId request parameter in the log and TaskManager query operations
DeploymentInstanceId.description_zh: 本次操作关联的部署运行实例ID，对应日志和TaskManager查询接口的 DeploymentInstanceId 入参
DeploymentInstanceId.title_en: 本次操作关联的部署运行实例ID
DeploymentInstanceId.title_zh: 本次操作关联的部署运行实例ID

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the operation. The time is in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format. If the operation has not ended, this parameter may be null
EndTime.description_zh: 操作结束时间，格式 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss；尚无结束时间时可能为null

LogContent.description_en: The operation logs. In the ListStreamOpsRecords operation, this parameter may be a log storage identity. After you invoke the GetStreamOpsRecord operation, the log content or operation information is returned
LogContent.description_zh: 操作日志。ListStreamOpsRecords 中可能为日志存储标识，调用 GetStreamOpsRecord 后返回日志正文或操作信息

Operate.description_en: The operation type. Valid values: START, PAUSE, RESUME, and STOP. This parameter does not indicate the running status of the task
Operate.description_zh: 操作类型：START启动、PAUSE暂停、RESUME恢复、STOP停止；不是任务运行状态

OpsRecordId.description_en: The ID of the operation record. This ID corresponds to the OpsRecordId request parameter in the GetStreamOpsRecord operation
OpsRecordId.description_zh: 操作记录ID，对应 GetStreamOpsRecord 的 OpsRecordId 入参

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the operation. The time is in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format
StartTime.description_zh: 操作开始时间，格式 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

Data.title_en: 获取单条启停操作记录及日志正文
Data.title_zh: 获取单条启停操作记录及日志正文

Message.description_en: The details of the backend response exception

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
